title: MOTION (PARK - LEE) relative to funding for overtime costs related to preventing crimes and aggravated assaults at homeless encampments in Council District 11.
text:
[Council File 26-1570; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (PARK - LEE) relative to funding for overtime costs related to preventing crimes and aggravated assaults at homeless encampments in Council District 11.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER AND APPROPRIATE $75,000 from the General City Purposes Fund No. 100-56, Account No. 000625 (Additional Homeless Services - CD 11) to the Police Fund No. 100-70, Account No. I 092 (Overtime - Police Officers) for overtime costs related to preventing crimes and aggravated assaults at homeless encampments in Council District 11.
2. AUTHORIZE the Police Department to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
